episodes.synopsis: On her first day of high school, Tanaka realizes that she's made a grave mistake - because she slept through the entrance exam. Oops.
episodes.title: Amazing

episodes.synopsis: Because Baka is just too ridiculous, Wota asks Robo to read her manga - but on second thought, the literal-minded Robo might not have been a good choice, either.
episodes.title: Manga

episodes.synopsis: Loli is NOT LITTLE, dammit. And she can handle a solo trip to the grocery store just fine - so long as she can avoid that jerk-face Baka, that is.
episodes.title: Forgotten Item

episodes.synopsis: Majime desperately wants to get to know Robo. Does Baka hold the key to striking up an interesting conversation?
episodes.title: Majime

episodes.synopsis: A new transfer student arrives. She's beautiful. She's half Austrian. She loves girls. She's... allergic to Baka? What??!
episodes.title: Lily

episodes.synopsis: Majo is a bit socially awkward, but she means well. You just have to get past her friendship bracelets made of body parts and games that predict how you’ll die, that’s all!
episodes.title: Majo

episodes.synopsis: Yamai sure does wear a lot of bandages... but such is the curse of the half-blood scion of the Atlantia and Dragonia races!
episodes.title: Yamai

episodes.synopsis: It’s summertime, and that mean it’s time for spoOoOoOoky stories! But is the real horror Baka’s terrifying tale, or what lies in wait for them at school after hours…?
episodes.title: Buying Swimwear

episodes.synopsis: After getting disrespected by some brats on the street, Loli decides it’s time to update her look. The results are… well, they’re something. Let’s leave it at that.
episodes.title: Fashion

episodes.synopsis: It's time for the first years to choose either the Humanities or the Science Course. You wouldn't think this could cause a fight between Baka and Wota, but you'd be wrong.
episodes.title: Robo

episodes.synopsis: They say you should never meet your idols. They might end up being your homeroom teacher in disguise. Whomp whomp.
episodes.title: Dream

episodes.synopsis: Baka's grades are REALLY BAD. She might not get to advance a grade if she fails a single test. Is studying even worth it? Eh, probably not. Time to run away to a pig farm…
